verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a downloadable tool that runs real conversions locally (e.g. `ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.avi`), and a community user notes it 'never hits a commercial paywall.' That means developers can test real conversions without any trial or payment gate, which exceeds a free tier. missing for 10: first-party statement of free/open-source licensing or no-cost use in the evidence pack, corroboration beyond a single community comment.
